measurement: Release Wasm and dist/**/*.js; gzip level 9 per module. Runtime, react and testing retain their existing limits. nativeContent counts content/native.js and testing/native-document.js separately, with about 5% raw/gzip headroom; shared content helpers remain in runtime. Graph is a separate minified Vite ESM library build of both graph entry points, including lazy Sigma/graphology and transitive dependencies with the optional React peer external. javascript aggregates ordinary dist modules plus that graph build. Shared storage codec is counted in runtime and graph. Native content and graph never enter the reader's first-screen import chain.
